llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam signs: abnormally steep discounts (up to 50%) on a known popular brand, generic and ambiguous privacy policy lacking concrete company or contact info, SSL certificate warnings, absence of identifiable business details (business name, real address, VAT, or legal owner), and failed or inaccessible contact/info pages. These are consistent with characteristics of fraudulent online shopping sites aiming to deceive customers into making purchases without actual delivery or recourse.
